updates.description: Wrapped graphify CLI with Pi extension tools and commands
Added graphify_extract tool for headless CI extraction with backend selection
Added graphify_export_callflow tool for Mermaid architecture HTML generation

Reviewed upstream 0.7.14–0.8.14: added claude-cli and deepseek backends, resolution/excludeHubs/exclude params to graphify_extract. Noted .worktrees/ skip and .gitignore fallback (0.8.14). Deferred: graphify prs, cache-check subcommands.

Thin-layer refactoring: replaced 424 lines of inline Python with CLI delegation to graphify. buildGraph, queryGraph, findPath, explainNode, addUrl, updateGraph, clusterOnly now call graphify CLI directly. Removed detectFiles().
